permission_detail:
macOS has not authorized this running copy of WindowMochi yet. The system request may still be pending.

Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility. If WindowMochi is already enabled, quit the app, remove the old WindowMochi or WindowHabit entry with the minus button, then use the plus button to add this exact app:
%@

Enable it and reopen the same app. Local rebuilds can invalidate an earlier authorization even when the switch still appears on.

about_detail:
Your little mochi helper for a tidy desktop.
Save window layouts and restore them across screens.

Version %@
permission_enabled_detail: WindowMochi is authorized to control windows. You can now save or restore a layout.
delete_layout_detail: This removes the saved layout only. Your open windows will stay where they are. Remaining layouts shift up in the list, which changes their number shortcuts. This cannot be undone.
shots_hint: Newest 30 images • Drag a thumbnail to share the original file. New screenshots appear after macOS saves them.
shots_not_setup: Choose a screenshots folder or use Set up folder to create Pictures/WindowMochi/Screenshots.
shots_choose_hint: Choose a dedicated screenshots folder. WindowMochi displays image files in this folder only; this does not change the macOS screenshot save location.
shots_location_help:
To save future screenshots here:
%@

1. Copy the path and open Screenshot using the button below.
2. Select a screenshot mode, then Options → Save to → Other Location.
3. Press Command + Shift + G, paste the path, and choose that folder.
4. Take a test screenshot and check this shelf.

macOS controls this setting. Creating a folder here does not change it automatically.
shots_empty: No images yet. Finish setting the macOS save location, then take a screenshot. Clipboard-only captures are not included.
shots_count: Recent images: %d • drag thumbnails to other apps
shots_read_error: Cannot read this folder: %@. Use Choose folder to grant access again.
shots_drag: Drag to share the original image file
shots_missing: The image is missing or cannot be read. Refresh the list and try again.
shots_copy_error: The image could not be copied to the clipboard.
shots_desktop_hint: Select your Desktop folder. Only images carrying the macOS screenshot metadata flag will be offered for review.
shots_no_candidates: No images with the macOS screenshot flag were found in this folder. Unmarked images are left alone.
shots_import_help:
Select the screenshots to move to:
%@

Nothing is selected by default. Only checked files will move; duplicate names keep both files. Unchecked files stay in place. You can move files back later using Finder.
shots_launch_help: Could not open Screenshot: %@. The folder path is copied. Press Command + Shift + 5 yourself, then Options → Save to → Other Location to finish setup.
